critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 106: `member=Depends(lambda: None)` is a no-op dependency (dead code). Harmless but should be removed for clarity.

CORS allow_origins reads a single string via env; if CORS_ORIGINS unset it falls back to '*' which is incompatible with allow_credentials=True per spec. Currently owner APIs use Bearer header so it works, but the httpOnly cookie path is not usable cross-origin. Consider explicit origin list.
server.py is a single ~170 line file — acceptable now but slug/PIN routes and admin routes could be split as it grows.
clean_task pops _id but most reads already use projection {_id:0}; consistent projection use is good.
